summary.text: R&D Lead and Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience building and scaling e-commerce platforms and enterprise systems end-to-end. Led digital transformation initiatives and built HIPAA-compliant healthcare solutions serving thousands of users. Proven expertise in architecting resilient multi-layer systems and creating seamless integrations between Shopify, HubSpot, and cloud platforms. Specialized in developing customer-centric solutions with meticulous UX focus that drive conversion and retention. Pioneer in integrating production-ready AI agents and automation to reduce manual workflows and accelerate decision-making. Strong ability to align technical solutions with business objectives and deliver measurable outcomes.
